title: Crazy Gopalan
desc: Gopalan, a notorious thief, teams up with Lakshmanan and continues to rob people. Their lives change when they kidnap a rich girl and find themselves trapped.

title: Mazhavil Kavadi
desc: Velayudhankutty, a villager, goes to a city to earn a living to marry his lover, Amminikutty. But many unexpected turns of events happen when he goes to an unknown city.

title: Chess
desc: A man murders his rich brother-in-law with the help of three co-conspirators to amass his wealth. He also manages to discredit the deceased man's illegitimate son.

title: Ambili
desc: Ambili, a naive and wide-eyed young man, is adored by everyone for his quirky traits. He hopes to marry his childhood love, Tina, and restore the lost bond with his friend and Tina's brother, Bobby.

title: Mr. Butler
desc: Gopalakrishnan, a chef, escapes from his village to a city when his marriage gets ruined. Later, he falls in love with Radhika, but his happiness is short-lived as his past returns to haunt him.

title: Kadha Parayumbol
desc: Balan, a barber, struggles to give his family a better living. However, his life changes when his old friend, who is a film star, comes to his village for a film shoot.
